summary: PLAT-103-1/2/3 shipped in one mono PR #1 (CI+CD green): validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty; core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing 'payments' (from package.json team). Also fixed sub-route-reports (owner 'insights') since it calls validateApp and would have broken; reports isn't deployed by CD. shared-contracts is inlined at build time (no registry release/version bump needed; one PR so the lib and apps land together).
